name: MCNASH15
tagline: Intel Core Ultra NAS PC with six 2.5GbE ports and optional 10G SFP+
description: MCNASH15 offers Intel Core Ultra 155H / 165H / 185H processor options, up to 96GB DDR5, six Intel i226 2.5GbE ports, dual M.2 PCIe storage and SATA. The standard H15-155H-6L configuration can be ordered with two or four additional 10G SFP+ ports. The 165 x 154 x 78 mm enclosure uses 19V DC input.
operatingRange: 0°C to 50°C with commercial HDD; -20°C to 50°C with industrial SSD
